added: Ship enterprise-ready features on day one. Only pay for what you use. Get started for free
Amplify app frontends are powered by fully-managed AWS services. Many offer generous Free Tiers to get started and pay as you go pricing thereafter. No monthly minimums - simply pay for what you use.
Always free. Quickly develop production-ready UI with dozens of pre-built, themeable, and responsive cloud-connected React components and forms.
removed: Use Amplify tools as much or as little as you need. Get started at $0, then only pay for what you use.
Get started free, then pay as you go
Pay as you go, starting with free offers*
AWS backend services deployed by Amplify CLI or Amplify Studio are offered on the AWS free tier and pay as you go: API Gateway
The free offer is per account, regardless of number of users. It expires at the end of your 12-month AWS Free Tier term then converts to pay as you go.
Need more capacity than the free tier? Amplify switches over to pay as you go pricing once you exceed free tier limits, with no disruption to your apps.
Instantly get access to the AWS Free Tier.
